name: prompt_version
description: Prompt version scored, e.g. earnings_v1. One run = (model, prompt_version, dataset_version).

name: dataset_version
description: Golden dataset version the labels came from, e.g. golden_v1.

name: n_documents
description: Labeled goldens actually scored (had a matching extraction).

name: n_skipped
description: Labeled goldens with no extraction for this (model, prompt_version) — a coverage gap, kept visible.

name: overall_accuracy
description: Micro-average correct/total across all fields. NULL when nothing was scored.

name: field_scores
description: Per-field outcome tallies — the report, not the headline. Query to compare a field across prompt versions.

fields.name: accuracy
fields.description: correct/total, or NULL when the field was never scored.
